issue: In IN_SFY24_Q1_fundable.csv the PWSID No. column is read as numeric (range 5225003–5292007), meaning leading zeros would be lost if any PWSID starts with a zero. Still, fread with colClasses='character' should preserve these, but the column header in Q1 is 'PWSID\nNo.' while in Q4 it is 'PWSID\nNo' (no trailing period). After janitor::clean_names() these become different R column names ('pwsid_no' vs 'pwsid_no' potentially), but a mismatch could cause the pwsid split logic to reference a NA column.
suggestion: After clean_names(), print or assert that the PWSID column is named identically across all four files before bind_rows. Explicitly set colClasses to character for the PWSID column in fread calls.
